evidence: Landed under the Mining label and modifies src/node/block_template_manager.*, src/interfaces/mining.h, and src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp to track block template memory.
rationale: Adds template memory accounting and an IPC query demanded by external miners. It addresses unmonitored memory retention when external clients keep template references after mempool eviction, directly integrating with the Stratum v2 template provider (stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63).
